correctness.rationale: Exact gap intervals follow from the q-generator bound. Counting multiples yields the stated floor sum; complete p-block decomposition and the classical floor-sum gcd identity yield the exact quadratic formula. Two isolated coefficient-comparison arguments establish least period: for odd p, branches at 0 and p differ by -1/4; for even p≥4, branches at 1 and p+1 differ by the strictly positive displayed constant. The special p=4 linear coefficient and p=2 full formula are handled explicitly. Separately implemented dynamic programming matched the formula on 3375 parameter pairs, with 1978 branch tests and 98 finite coefficient-period checks; all infinite conclusions rest on algebra.
